This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

Documentation exists to advance work, not to hoard information. Four steps when handling information:

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

1	# u2-l1 · index 解析与 KimiK2WeightManifest
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲，你应该能够：
6	
7	1. 说出 `model.safetensors.index.json` 的 `weight_map` 长什么样，以及 crate 如何把它解析成一棵「张量目录树」`KimiK2WeightManifest`。
8	2. 独立推导 Kimi-K2.6 checkpoint 里全部 `language_model.*` 张量的名字：顶层 3 个 + 61 层（第 0 层 dense、其余 60 层 MoE），并用公式算出总张量数。
9	3. 理解 `validate` 的两层合同：结构校验（61 层、60 个 MoE 层）与并行整除校验（专家对 EP、头与词表对 TP），以及 `with_parallel_shape` 为什么会在换拓扑时重新校验。
10	4. 写出调用 `KimiK2WeightManifest::from_index_json` 的单元测试，验证「名字齐全则通过、缺一个名字则报出那个名字」。
11	
12	本讲是单元 2（权重加载）的第一讲：只处理**名字与结构**，不打开任何 shard 的字节——mmap 与 GPU 上载留给 u2-l4，rank 切片推导留给 u2-l2。
13	
14	## 2. 前置知识
15	
16	### 2.1 safetensors 与 index.json
17	
18	大模型的权重通常切成几十个 `*.safetensors` 分片（shard）文件。safetensors 是一种「头部 JSON 元数据 + 尾部裸张量字节」的格式，每个分片头部记录了本文件内每个张量的名字、dtype 和形状。
19	
20	问题是：推理引擎拿到张量名 `language_model.model.layers.7.mlp.experts.123.gate_proj.weight_packed` 时，怎么知道它躺在哪个分片文件里？答案就是索引文件 `model.safetensors.index.json`，它的核心字段 `weight_map` 是一张「张量名 → 分片文件名」的表：
21	
22	```json
23	{
24	  "metadata": { "total_size": ... },
25	  "weight_map": {
26	    "language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight": "model-00001-of-00064.safetensors",
27	    "language_model.model.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight": "model-00001-of-00064.safetensors",
28	    ...
29	  }
30	}
31	```
32	
33	### 2.2 什么是 manifest
34	
35	**manifest（清单）**：把扁平的 `weight_map` 字典重新组织成与模型结构同构的类型化树——「顶层 3 个张量 + 61 层，每层有 attention 部分，attention 之外是 dense MLP 或 MoE」。它是 checkpoint 与后续 rank 切分（u2-l2）、显存装载（u2-l4）之间的中间表示。名字本身就是结构：`layers.0` 是第 0 层，`mlp.experts.123` 是第 123 号专家。
36	
37	### 2.3 前讲回顾（u1-l2 / u1-l3）
38	
39	- 几何常量全部写死在 [src/config.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L13-L41)：61 层（[src/config.rs:15-17](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L15-L17)）、384 个路由专家（[src/config.rs:30](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L30)）。

43	### 2.4 一个直觉比喻
44	
45	把 `weight_map` 想成一本没有目录的厚字典：8 万多个词条按字母序堆着。`KimiK2WeightManifest` 就是先按「模型图纸」把字典抄成一张带章节的目录卡——图纸来自 `config.rs` 的编译期常量。抄写过程中任何一页缺词条，立刻在「那一页」报错，而不是等到 GPU 上载时才炸。

63	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
64	
65	解析要解决三个问题：
66	
67	1. **找到索引文件**：crate 约定索引固定叫 `model.safetensors.index.json`，放在模型目录根部。
68	2. **只信名字，不碰字节**：`from_index_json` 只读 `weight_map` 里的字符串键值，不打开任何 `.safetensors` 分片。这使它可以在没有权重的机器上单测（现有测试就是这么做的）。
69	3. **确定性的错误报告**：用 `BTreeMap`（有序 map）保存中间结果，任何缺失的名字都能立刻定位到具体张量名，报错信息可直接用于排障。

76	       ├─ fs::read_to_string → serde_json 解析成 serde_json::Value

84	            ├─ 统计 text_tensor_count（language_model. 前缀的条目数）

151	### 4.2 layer manifest 结构：61 层的名字树与计数
152	
153	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
154	
155	manifest 的主体是 61 个 `KimiLayerManifest`。每层固定由两部分组成：
156	
157	- **attention 部分**：MLA（Multi-head Latent Attention）的 9 个张量，所有层都有；
158	- **kind 部分**：`KimiLayerKindManifest` 枚举，第 0 层是 `Dense`（普通 MLP），其余 60 层是 `Moe`。
159	
160	为什么第 0 层特殊？这是 Kimi-K2.6 的设计：config 里的 `first_k_dense_replace = 1`（probe 在 [src/config.rs:125-127](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L125-L127) 强制它等于 1），前 1 层用 dense MLP，之后全部换成 MoE。manifest 的分层判断与这个 config 语义严格对应。
161	
162	MoE 层的 routed expert 权重是 INT4 量化的：每个投影（gate/up/down）在 checkpoint 里是一个 `KimiInt4ProjectionManifest`，成对持有 `weight_packed`（打包的 4-bit 权重）与 `weight_scale`（每组缩放）。
163	
164	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
165	
166	```text
167	for layer_idx in 0..61:
168	    attention = attention_manifest(tensors, layer_idx)      # 9 个固定名字
169	    kind =
170	      if layer_idx < KIMI_K2_DENSE_LAYERS ( = 1 ):
171	          Dense( dense_mlp_manifest )                        # 3 个名字
172	      else:
173	          Moe( moe_layer_manifest )                          # 2 + 3 + 384×3×2 个名字
174	             ├─ router:        mlp.gate.weight + mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias
175	             ├─ shared_experts: gate/up/down_proj.weight
176	             └─ routed_experts: for expert_idx in 0..384:
177	                    int4_projection_manifest(gate_proj / up_proj / down_proj)
178	                      → {projection}.weight_packed + {projection}.weight_scale
179	```

181	统一命名模板：`language_model.model.layers.{layer_idx}.{suffix}`，由 [src/weights/manifest.rs:711-720](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L711-L720) 的 `layer_tensor` 拼出。

328	### 4.3 text-only 门与 validate 整除校验
329	
330	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
331	
332	两个互不相同的校验容易被混淆，本讲把它们分清：
333	
334	1. **text-only 门**（`ensure_text_only_model_index`，在 load.rs）：确认索引里**存在**文本张量（至少一个 `language_model.*` 条目）。它保证「这是一个文本模型（或至少含文本部分）的索引」，完全空白的索引立刻拒绝。至于索引里多出来的其他张量（例如多模态模型的视觉塔权重），门并不拒绝——它们只是永远不被 manifest 引用、也永远不被加载。
335	2. **validate**（manifest 私有方法）：结构合同 + 并行形状合同。`from_index_json` 结束时和 `with_parallel_shape` 换拓扑时都会调用。
336	
337	`validate` 的并行整除校验是纯算术：**专家数对 EP 整除、头数与词表数对 TP 整除**。这一步不通过，后面 u2-l2 的 rank 切分（`local_experts = 384 / ep_world`、`heads_per_tp = 64 / tp_world`、`vocab_per_tp = 163840 / tp_world`）就会产生零头甚至除零。
338	
339	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
340	
341	```text
342	启动期（bringup）:
343	  ensure_text_only_model_index(model_path)
344	    ├─ KimiK2WeightManifest::from_model_dir(...)   # 解析 + 默认 tp8_ep8 + validate
345	    └─ text_tensor_count == 0 ? 报错 : 返回 manifest
346	  manifest.with_parallel_shape(实际拓扑 shape)     # 替换 parallel 后再次 validate
347	
348	validate(manifest):
349	  ├─ layers.len() == 61 ?
350	  ├─ MoE 层数 == 60 ?
351	  └─ ep_world > 0 且 384 % ep_world == 0
352	              且 64 % tp_world == 0 且 163840 % tp_world == 0 ?
353	```
354	
355	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
356	
357	**text-only 门**：
358	
359	[src/weights/load.rs:67-73](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/load.rs#L67-L73) `ensure_text_only_model_index` 调用 `from_model_dir` 拿到 manifest，若 `text_tensor_count == 0` 则报 `Kimi safetensors index contains no language_model tensors`。这是启动链路上第一道与权重的接触：真实调用点在 [src/runner/bringup.rs:96-97](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/runner/bringup.rs#L96-L97)，紧跟着 `with_parallel_shape(shape)` 把默认拓扑换成实际启动拓扑。
360	
361	**with_parallel_shape：一次替换、二次校验**：
362	
363	[src/weights/manifest.rs:241-245](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L241-L245) 消费 `self`、替换 `parallel` 字段后**重新 `validate`**，失败即返回错误。它是 builder 风格：`from_index_json` 默认写入 `tp8_ep8()`（[src/weights/manifest.rs:235](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L235)），TP1/DP8 启动路径靠它切换。
364	
365	**validate 三连**：
366	
367	[src/weights/manifest.rs:247-273](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L247-L273)：
368	
369	- L248-L252：层数必须等于 `KIMI_K2_LAYERS`（61）——`from_index_json` 的循环本身就固定生成 61 层，这条在校验来自其他路径构造的 manifest（如测试工厂）时起作用；
370	- L253-L261：`kind` 为 `Moe` 的层数必须等于 `KIMI_K2_MOE_LAYERS`（60）；
371	- L262-L271：并行合同，即
372	
373	\[ 384 \bmod ep\_world = 0,\quad 64 \bmod tp\_world = 0,\quad 163840 \bmod tp\_world = 0,\quad ep\_world > 0 \]
374	
375	  失败时报 `Kimi parallel shape TP{tp}/DP{dp}/EP{ep} does not evenly divide model dimensions`。
376	
377	对照两种合法拓扑：`tp8_ep8`（\(tp=8, ep=8\)）与 `tp1_dp8`（\(tp=1, dp=8, ep=8\)）都满足三条整除；假想的 `tp3` 会在 \(64 \bmod 3 \ne 0\) 处被拦下。
378	
379	**为什么头和词表跟 TP、专家跟 EP**：TP（张量并行）把注意力头与词表行切到各 rank——头数 64、词表 163,840 必须被 tp_world 整除；EP（专家并行）把 384 个完整专家划给各 rank——专家数必须被 ep_world 整除。这条规则正是 u1-l2 `KimiK2ParallelShape::new`（[src/config.rs:325-335](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L325-L335)）做除法的前提，validate 提前把不整除的拓扑挡在除法之前。

455	- `from_model_dir → from_index_file → from_index_json` 三级入口把 `model.safetensors.index.json` 的 `weight_map`（张量名 → 分片文件）收进有序 `BTreeMap`，全程只读名字、不打开任何 shard 字节。
456	- manifest 是一棵与模型同构的名字树：顶层 3 个张量 + 61 层（第 0 层 dense、`layer_idx < 1` 分界）+ 每 MoE 层 2 router + 3 shared + 384 专家 × 3 投影 × 2 个 INT4 名字（`weight_packed`/`weight_scale`）。
457	- `text_tensor_count` 按 `language_model.` 前缀统计原始索引：自造最小集 139,095，真实 checkpoint 因多出 `weight_shape` 而是 208,215；`ensure_text_only_model_index` 用它拒绝完全没有文本张量的索引。
458	- `validate` 是双重合同：结构（61 层、60 MoE 层）+ 并行整除（384 % EP、64 % TP、163840 % TP）；`with_parallel_shape` 换拓扑（默认 tp8_ep8 → 实际启动形状）时重新校验。
459	- 报错即诊断：缺什么名字、哪条整除失败，错误字符串都带具体对象；`from_index_json` 可在无权重机器上单测。
460	
461	## 7. 下一步学习建议
462	
463	- **u2-l2（rank 切分计划）**：本讲刻意绕过了 `rank_plan` / `rank_weight_names` / `rank_sliced_load_plan`（[src/weights/manifest.rs:275-490](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L275-L490)）——它们在 manifest 之上做 TP 头区间、EP 专家区间、词表区间的推导，是下一讲的全部内容。可先自行浏览 `KimiRankWeightPlan` 的三个 `Range` 字段。
464	- **u2-l3 / u2-l4**：INT4 权重如何重排成 Marlin 布局、mmap 切片如何上载 GPU，完成「名字 → 显存字节」的最后一公里。
465	- 顺带阅读 [src/weights/tests.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/tests.rs) 的 `rank_sliced_load_plan_applies_tp8_ep8_slices`（L62-L182），预习下讲将出现的 `KimiTensorLoadSlice::RowRange/ColRange` 语义。

# u2-l1 · index 解析与 KimiK2WeightManifest

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `model.safetensors.index.json` 的 `weight_map` 长什么样，以及 crate 如何把它解析成一棵「张量目录树」`KimiK2WeightManifest`。
2. 独立推导 Kimi-K2.6 checkpoint 里全部 `language_model.*` 张量的名字：顶层 3 个 + 61 层（第 0 层 dense、其余 60 层 MoE），并用公式算出总张量数。
3. 理解 `validate` 的两层合同：结构校验（61 层、60 个 MoE 层）与并行整除校验（专家对 EP、头与词表对 TP），以及 `with_parallel_shape` 为什么会在换拓扑时重新校验。
4. 写出调用 `KimiK2WeightManifest::from_index_json` 的单元测试，验证「名字齐全则通过、缺一个名字则报出那个名字」。

本讲是单元 2（权重加载）的第一讲：只处理**名字与结构**，不打开任何 shard 的字节——mmap 与 GPU 上载留给 u2-l4，rank 切片推导留给 u2-l2。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 safetensors 与 index.json

大模型的权重通常切成几十个 `*.safetensors` 分片（shard）文件。safetensors 是一种「头部 JSON 元数据 + 尾部裸张量字节」的格式，每个分片头部记录了本文件内每个张量的名字、dtype 和形状。

问题是：推理引擎拿到张量名 `language_model.model.layers.7.mlp.experts.123.gate_proj.weight_packed` 时，怎么知道它躺在哪个分片文件里？答案就是索引文件 `model.safetensors.index.json`，它的核心字段 `weight_map` 是一张「张量名 → 分片文件名」的表：

```json
{
  "metadata": { "total_size": ... },
  "weight_map": {
    "language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight": "model-00001-of-00064.safetensors",
    "language_model.model.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight": "model-00001-of-00064.safetensors",
    ...
  }
}
```

### 2.2 什么是 manifest

**manifest（清单）**：把扁平的 `weight_map` 字典重新组织成与模型结构同构的类型化树——「顶层 3 个张量 + 61 层，每层有 attention 部分，attention 之外是 dense MLP 或 MoE」。它是 checkpoint 与后续 rank 切分（u2-l2）、显存装载（u2-l4）之间的中间表示。名字本身就是结构：`layers.0` 是第 0 层，`mlp.experts.123` 是第 123 号专家。

### 2.3 前讲回顾（u1-l2 / u1-l3）

- 几何常量全部写死在 [src/config.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L13-L41)：61 层（[src/config.rs:15-17](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L15-L17)）、384 个路由专家（[src/config.rs:30](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L30)）。
- `KimiK2ParallelShape`（[src/config.rs:287-295](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L287-L295)）由 `tp_world × dp_world = ep_world` 推出每 rank 本地切片，两种合法拓扑 `tp8_ep8()` / `tp1_dp8()` 的 `local_experts` 都是 48。
- crate 采用扁平模块布局（`weights.rs` 模块根 + `weights/` 目录，无 `mod.rs`），`weights` 子树整体挂在 `kimi-k2` feature 之后（[src/lib.rs:33-34](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/lib.rs#L33-L34)）。

### 2.4 一个直觉比喻

把 `weight_map` 想成一本没有目录的厚字典：8 万多个词条按字母序堆着。`KimiK2WeightManifest` 就是先按「模型图纸」把字典抄成一张带章节的目录卡——图纸来自 `config.rs` 的编译期常量。抄写过程中任何一页缺词条，立刻在「那一页」报错，而不是等到 GPU 上载时才炸。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 本讲关注点 |
|------|-----------|
| [src/weights.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights.rs) | 模块根：常量 `KIMI_K2_WEIGHT_INDEX`、`TEXT_PREFIX`，子模块声明与再导出 |
| [src/weights/manifest.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs) | **本讲主文件**：manifest 类型树、`from_index_json` 解析、`validate` 校验（以及本讲只预告的 rank 切分方法） |
| [src/weights/load.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/load.rs) | text-only 门 `ensure_text_only_model_index`、切片类型 `KimiTensorLoadSlice` 等（GPU 装载函数本身属 u2-l4） |
| [src/weights/tests.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/tests.rs) | 现有测试：`tiny_manifest` 工厂、缺失张量报错测试，是本讲实践的模板 |
| [src/runner/bringup.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/runner/bringup.rs) | manifest 的真实消费者：启动时解析 + `with_parallel_shape` 换拓扑 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

本讲的三个最小模块：**weight_map 解析**（4.1）、**layer manifest 结构**（4.2）、**text-only 门与校验**（4.3）。

### 4.1 weight_map 解析：从 index.json 到张量目录

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

解析要解决三个问题：

1. **找到索引文件**：crate 约定索引固定叫 `model.safetensors.index.json`，放在模型目录根部。
2. **只信名字，不碰字节**：`from_index_json` 只读 `weight_map` 里的字符串键值，不打开任何 `.safetensors` 分片。这使它可以在没有权重的机器上单测（现有测试就是这么做的）。
3. **确定性的错误报告**：用 `BTreeMap`（有序 map）保存中间结果，任何缺失的名字都能立刻定位到具体张量名，报错信息可直接用于排障。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
from_model_dir(model_path)                     # 入口：给目录
  └─ from_index_file(model_path/model.safetensors.index.json)
       ├─ fs::read_to_string → serde_json 解析成 serde_json::Value
       └─ from_index_json(json)
            ├─ 取 json.weight_map，必须是对象且每个 value 是字符串
            ├─ 全部条目收进 BTreeMap<张量名, shard 文件名>
            ├─ 取 3 个顶层张量（embed_tokens / norm / lm_head），缺失即报错
            ├─ for layer_idx in 0..61：
            │    ├─ attention_manifest(...)        # 9 个名字
            │    └─ layer_idx < 1 ? dense_mlp_manifest : moe_layer_manifest
            ├─ 统计 text_tensor_count（language_model. 前缀的条目数）
            └─ validate()  ← 全部通过才返回 manifest
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**索引文件名与前缀常量**定义在模块根：

[src/weights.rs:61-62](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights.rs#L61-L62) 定义了 `KIMI_K2_WEIGHT_INDEX = "model.safetensors.index.json"` 与 `TEXT_PREFIX = "language_model."`——前者是索引文件名，后者是「文本权重」的身份前缀，4.3 节会再次用到。

**入口三级跳**：

[src/weights/manifest.rs:183-193](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L183-L193) 中，`from_model_dir` 只是拼出索引路径，`from_index_file` 负责读文件与 JSON 解析（两层 `with_context` 分别报「读失败」「解析失败」），真正的工作在 `from_index_json`。

**weight_map 的读取与净化**：

[src/weights/manifest.rs:196-206](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L196-L206) 先用 `json.get("weight_map")` 拿到映射，缺失则报 `Kimi safetensors index missing weight_map`；然后逐条校验每个 value 必须是字符串（分片文件名），全部插入 `BTreeMap<&str, &str>`。注意这里**没有**过滤前缀——所有条目都进表，前缀过滤只发生在「按名字查找」和 `text_tensor_count` 统计时。

**顶层 3 个张量**：

[src/weights/manifest.rs:208-210](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L208-L210) 按固定名字取词嵌入、最终归一化与输出头：

| manifest 字段 | checkpoint 张量名 |
|---|---|
| `token_embedding` | `language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight` |
| `final_norm` | `language_model.model.norm.weight` |
| `lm_head` | `language_model.lm_head.weight` |

注意 `lm_head` 的路径与另外两个不同：它直接挂在 `language_model.` 下而没有 `model.` 中段——这是 HF 命名习惯，代码里按完整字符串逐字匹配。

**查找函数 `tensor`**：

[src/weights/manifest.rs:722-730](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L722-L730) 是所有取名的终点：`BTreeMap` 查不到就报 `Kimi text manifest missing tensor {name}`。每个 `KimiTensorEntry`（[src/weights/manifest.rs:8-11](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L8-L11)）只携带 `name` 与 `shard` 两个字符串——名字到分片的映射就是它唯一记录的信息。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践：列出真实（或手写）weight_map 的张量名

1. **实践目标**：亲眼看到 `weight_map` 的键集合，并与 4.2 节的命名规则对上。
2. **操作步骤**：
   - 有真实 Kimi-K2 权重目录时（示例代码，路径按需替换）：

     ```bash
     python3 -c "
     import json
     wm = json.load(open('models/Kimi-K2/model.safetensors.index.json'))['weight_map']
     text = sorted(k for k in wm if k.startswith('language_model.'))
     print('total entries:', len(wm))
     print('language_model.* entries:', len(text))
     print('shards:', len(set(wm.values())))
     print('\n'.join(text[:12]))
     "
     ```

   - 没有权重时，把上面的脚本指向任意一个 safetensors 索引（例如 HuggingFace 上任何分片模型），只看结构不看数值。
3. **需要观察的现象**：`language_model.*` 条目数；去重后的分片文件数（真实 Kimi-K2.6 checkpoint 是 64 个分片，与测试工厂里写死的 `model-00001-of-00064.safetensors` 一致，见 [src/weights/tests.rs:293-298](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/tests.rs#L293-L298)）；打印出的前几个名字是否都是 `language_model.model.layers.0.*` 形态。
4. **预期结果**：真实 checkpoint 的 `language_model.*` 计数应为 208,215（推导见 4.2.3 的计数表）。若你的计数不同，先检查是否混入了非文本（如视觉塔）张量前缀。
5. 本讲作者未在本地运行该脚本，具体数值**待本地验证**。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`from_index_json` 对一个完全没有 `weight_map` 键的 JSON 会怎么报错？对 `weight_map` 里某条 value 是数字的 JSON 呢？

**答案**：前者命中 [src/weights/manifest.rs:197-199](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L197-L199)，报 `Kimi safetensors index missing weight_map`；后者命中 [src/weights/manifest.rs:201-205](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L201-L205)，报 `weight_map entry {name} is not a shard string`，报错里带具体条目名。

**练习 2**：为什么中间表用 `BTreeMap` 而不是 `HashMap`？

**答案**：两者在这里的正确性相同（按键查找），但 `BTreeMap` 的迭代有序，使任何依赖遍历顺序的逻辑（例如后续按 shard 分组）天然确定，报错与测试输出可复现；这与仓库在 [src/weights/load.rs:90](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/load.rs#L90)（`tensors: BTreeMap`）与 `rank_sliced_load_plan`（[src/weights/manifest.rs:332-340](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L332-L340) 按 shard 的 `BTreeMap` 分组）的用法一致。

### 4.2 layer manifest 结构：61 层的名字树与计数

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

manifest 的主体是 61 个 `KimiLayerManifest`。每层固定由两部分组成：

- **attention 部分**：MLA（Multi-head Latent Attention）的 9 个张量，所有层都有；
- **kind 部分**：`KimiLayerKindManifest` 枚举，第 0 层是 `Dense`（普通 MLP），其余 60 层是 `Moe`。

为什么第 0 层特殊？这是 Kimi-K2.6 的设计：config 里的 `first_k_dense_replace = 1`（probe 在 [src/config.rs:125-127](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L125-L127) 强制它等于 1），前 1 层用 dense MLP，之后全部换成 MoE。manifest 的分层判断与这个 config 语义严格对应。

MoE 层的 routed expert 权重是 INT4 量化的：每个投影（gate/up/down）在 checkpoint 里是一个 `KimiInt4ProjectionManifest`，成对持有 `weight_packed`（打包的 4-bit 权重）与 `weight_scale`（每组缩放）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
for layer_idx in 0..61:
    attention = attention_manifest(tensors, layer_idx)      # 9 个固定名字
    kind =
      if layer_idx < KIMI_K2_DENSE_LAYERS ( = 1 ):
          Dense( dense_mlp_manifest )                        # 3 个名字
      else:
          Moe( moe_layer_manifest )                          # 2 + 3 + 384×3×2 个名字
             ├─ router:        mlp.gate.weight + mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias
             ├─ shared_experts: gate/up/down_proj.weight
             └─ routed_experts: for expert_idx in 0..384:
                    int4_projection_manifest(gate_proj / up_proj / down_proj)
                      → {projection}.weight_packed + {projection}.weight_scale
```

统一命名模板：`language_model.model.layers.{layer_idx}.{suffix}`，由 [src/weights/manifest.rs:711-720](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L711-L720) 的 `layer_tensor` 拼出。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**类型树**（结构即文档）：

- [src/weights/manifest.rs:73-78](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L73-L78) `KimiLayerManifest { layer_idx, attention, kind }`；
- [src/weights/manifest.rs:67-71](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L67-L71) `KimiLayerKindManifest` 枚举只有 `Dense` / `Moe` 两个变体；
- [src/weights/manifest.rs:60-65](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L60-L65) `KimiMoeLayerManifest { router, shared_experts, routed_experts }`；
- [src/weights/manifest.rs:46-58](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L46-L58) INT4 投影与单个专家：`KimiInt4ProjectionManifest`（packed + scale）聚成 `KimiRoutedExpertManifest`（三个投影）。

**分层判断**在主循环里只有一行：

[src/weights/manifest.rs:212-224](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L212-L224) 对 `0..KIMI_K2_LAYERS`（61）逐层构造：`layer_idx < KIMI_K2_DENSE_LAYERS`（=1）走 `dense_mlp_manifest`，否则走 `moe_layer_manifest`。

**attention 的 9 个名字**（与 MLA 结构一一对应，u5-l2 会逐个用到）：

### 4.3 text-only 门与 validate 整除校验

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

两个互不相同的校验容易被混淆，本讲把它们分清：

1. **text-only 门**（`ensure_text_only_model_index`，在 load.rs）：确认索引里**存在**文本张量（至少一个 `language_model.*` 条目）。它保证「这是一个文本模型（或至少含文本部分）的索引」，完全空白的索引立刻拒绝。至于索引里多出来的其他张量（例如多模态模型的视觉塔权重），门并不拒绝——它们只是永远不被 manifest 引用、也永远不被加载。
2. **validate**（manifest 私有方法）：结构合同 + 并行形状合同。`from_index_json` 结束时和 `with_parallel_shape` 换拓扑时都会调用。

`validate` 的并行整除校验是纯算术：**专家数对 EP 整除、头数与词表数对 TP 整除**。这一步不通过，后面 u2-l2 的 rank 切分（`local_experts = 384 / ep_world`、`heads_per_tp = 64 / tp_world`、`vocab_per_tp = 163840 / tp_world`）就会产生零头甚至除零。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
启动期（bringup）:
  ensure_text_only_model_index(model_path)
    ├─ KimiK2WeightManifest::from_model_dir(...)   # 解析 + 默认 tp8_ep8 + validate
    └─ text_tensor_count == 0 ? 报错 : 返回 manifest
  manifest.with_parallel_shape(实际拓扑 shape)     # 替换 parallel 后再次 validate

validate(manifest):
  ├─ layers.len() == 61 ?
  ├─ MoE 层数 == 60 ?
  └─ ep_world > 0 且 384 % ep_world == 0
              且 64 % tp_world == 0 且 163840 % tp_world == 0 ?
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**text-only 门**：

[src/weights/load.rs:67-73](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/load.rs#L67-L73) `ensure_text_only_model_index` 调用 `from_model_dir` 拿到 manifest，若 `text_tensor_count == 0` 则报 `Kimi safetensors index contains no language_model tensors`。这是启动链路上第一道与权重的接触：真实调用点在 [src/runner/bringup.rs:96-97](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/runner/bringup.rs#L96-L97)，紧跟着 `with_parallel_shape(shape)` 把默认拓扑换成实际启动拓扑。

**with_parallel_shape：一次替换、二次校验**：

[src/weights/manifest.rs:241-245](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L241-L245) 消费 `self`、替换 `parallel` 字段后**重新 `validate`**，失败即返回错误。它是 builder 风格：`from_index_json` 默认写入 `tp8_ep8()`（[src/weights/manifest.rs:235](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L235)），TP1/DP8 启动路径靠它切换。

**validate 三连**：

[src/weights/manifest.rs:247-273](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L247-L273)：

- L248-L252：层数必须等于 `KIMI_K2_LAYERS`（61）——`from_index_json` 的循环本身就固定生成 61 层，这条在校验来自其他路径构造的 manifest（如测试工厂）时起作用；
- L253-L261：`kind` 为 `Moe` 的层数必须等于 `KIMI_K2_MOE_LAYERS`（60）；
- L262-L271：并行合同，即

\[ 384 \bmod ep\_world = 0,\quad 64 \bmod tp\_world = 0,\quad 163840 \bmod tp\_world = 0,\quad ep\_world > 0 \]

  失败时报 `Kimi parallel shape TP{tp}/DP{dp}/EP{ep} does not evenly divide model dimensions`。

对照两种合法拓扑：`tp8_ep8`（\(tp=8, ep=8\)）与 `tp1_dp8`（\(tp=1, dp=8, ep=8\)）都满足三条整除；假想的 `tp3` 会在 \(64 \bmod 3 \ne 0\) 处被拦下。

**为什么头和词表跟 TP、专家跟 EP**：TP（张量并行）把注意力头与词表行切到各 rank——头数 64、词表 163,840 必须被 tp_world 整除；EP（专家并行）把 384 个完整专家划给各 rank——专家数必须被 ep_world 整除。这条规则正是 u1-l2 `KimiK2ParallelShape::new`（[src/config.rs:325-335](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L325-L335)）做除法的前提，validate 提前把不整除的拓扑挡在除法之前。

**练习 2**：删除第 41 层第 200 号专家的 `up_proj.weight_scale`，报错信息长什么样？什么时候触发？

**答案**：`Kimi text manifest missing tensor language_model.model.layers.41.mlp.experts.200.up_proj.weight_scale`。触发时机在 `moe_layer_manifest` 遍历到第 41 层、`routed_expert_manifest` 构造该专家的 `up_proj` 时（[src/weights/manifest.rs:685-709](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/manifest.rs#L685-L709)）——注意 experts 是按 `0..384` 顺序构造的，所以前面的 199 个专家必须全部完整，错误才会轮到它。

**练习 3**：`from_index_json` 会校验张量的 dtype 或形状吗？

**答案**：不会。manifest 阶段只看名字与分片归属，不打开任何 shard；dtype 与形状的校验发生在装载时——`KimiTensorLoadSlice::local_shape`（[src/weights/load.rs:13-33](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/weights/load.rs#L13-L33)）会在切片时核对行/列范围是否落在真实形状内。这是刻意的分层：名字合同便宜、可无权重单测；字节合同昂贵、留给 u2-l4。
